items.cause: The AG terminal (...999) was closed from 12:48:55 to 14:01:42 (and restarted again 14:05:26). The FX runner calls mt5.initialize() without a terminal path (MT5_TERMINAL_PATH unset) and attached to the only logged-in terminal, the portable sandbox C:\MT5\VT-Sandbox on VTMarkets-Demo ...985; the DEMO guard passed because ...985 is also demo.
